sources.title: Human History Map: Annam 1920 index and decoded outlines
sources.note: Own-project factual-data exception for IDs, dates and geometry. Exact annam-1920 has two identical broad polygons, 1920 to 1930 and 1930 to 1938. Full decoded evidence in identity.json; northern extent includes Tonkin, westward extent exceeds modern Vietnamese frontier. No alias sharing.

sources.title: Johann Grémont, Governments and dynasties, BnF France-Vietnam heritage portal
sources.note: Direct original scholarly institutional essay, February 2021, paragraphs on treaties of 1883/1884, three colonial jurisdictions and colonial adaptation of mandarinate. Its September 1945 abdication date is not used: museum evidence dates the ceremony 30 August.

sources.title: Vietnam National Museum of History: Bảo Đại, the last emperor
sources.note: Direct original, 14 September 2016. Khải Định died 6 November 1925; Bảo Đại enthroned 8 January 1926, returned from study and issued assumption-of-rule decree in September 1932; 1933 reforms; 1945 declaration and abdication ceremony. Political characterizations and inaccurate later chronology are not adopted.

sources.title: David Biggs, Footprints of War, chapter Two: Terraforming
sources.note: Full original University of Washington Press chapter directly read. Airfield paragraphs and notes 37 to 40; 1930 protest against assaults and arrests, note 52. Attribution counted together for the whole book, including period title/summary. Not using erroneous Canton location for Communist unification meeting or simplified Popular Front dissolution chronology.

sources.title: Đỗ Bang, Đạm Phương: an intellectual pioneer, Journal of Science, Van Hien University 11 (2016), pp.44 to 52
sources.note: Original institutional PDF indexed text, printed p48: 1926 vocational institution at Hue; family/women/children education, support for 1927 school protests. Direct PDF fails, journal metadata directly read at js.vhu.edu.vn/index.php/vhujs/article/view/540. Reproducible query site.vhu.edu.vn "Đạm Phương" "gia đình" "1926". Specific facts used without heroic superlatives.

sources.title: Hue provincial tourism department: historical photographs of Đồng Khánh schoolgirls
sources.note: Original institutional indexed article read. Foundation ceremony 15 July 1917, metal box with nine Khai Dinh coins and two handwritten French records, citing BAVH 1917 no.4. Article identifies pre-1945 excursions but does not date every image; public prose preserves that broad scope. Direct timeout.

sources.title: Nghiên cứu và Phát triển 7(161), 2020: study of Đắc Lập and Tiếng Dân printing houses
sources.note: Original journal PDF indexed pp122 to 123 read. Tiếng Dân began 10 August 1927, acquired printing machinery; lists 1927 household medicine/first aid book, 1928 and 1931 women’s cookery volumes and named women contributors. Direct PDF timeout. Exact query full URL plus "TIẾNG DÂN" "Trần", or "nuôi thỏ" returns original pages. All passages counted as one work.

sources.title: Bibliothèque nationale de France, catalogue record for Phép nuôi gà (Huế,1929)
sources.note: Original indexed catalogue fully read; direct page technical error. Exact title Phép nuôi gà, Nguyễn Trọng Trử, Hué Tiêng-Dàn 1929, 68 pages; French gloss Procédés d’élevage des volailles. Holds physical copy 8-INDOCH-1180 and digitization NUMM-4230290. Public sample is catalogue-transcribed title in modern type, not claimed visual inspection of title page.

sources.title: HueWACO: history of the Hue waterworks
sources.note: Direct utility history, opening and periods 1909 to 1925 and 1926 to 1945. 1909 river pumping, hill settling/filtering; original users offices, French residents, selected Vietnamese officials and wealthy families. Expansion 1925/26; capacity 3700 cubic metres/day. Conflicting pipe lengths (15+20 versus54km) omitted. No inferred universal taps or flush toilets.

sources.title: Indochina statistical yearbook: 1930 eye-clinic activity
sources.note: Original colonial statistical document preserved by Southeast Asia data project; original indexed Table IX, Cliniques ophtalmologiques, mouvement des malades en1930, read. Hué row:9339 consultants,32472 consultations,1068 hospitalizations. PDF opens143pages but no extracted text. Figures remain administrative counts, not medical outcomes or population coverage.

sources.title: National Archives Centre I: labor provisions under Bảo Đại
sources.note: Original archival explanation by Hồng Nhung,1May2020, directly/indexed read. 1938 memorials concerning implementation of16November1937 labor law, unsafe employment of women/children and mine protection, Châu bản Bảo Đại volume36 folios40,53. Later1939/1941/1945 details deliberately not projected into map interval.

sources.title: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism: From Khai Dinh Musée to Hue Museum of Royal Antiquities exhibition
sources.note: Original institutional report25August2023, centenary of24August1923foundation. Specific surviving objects: seals,swords,throne,precious-metal books,ceramics,cloth and paper. Public text distinguishes modern exhibition from1923 inventory.

sources.title: British Museum, copper-alloy coin of Bảo Đại,1983,0619.226
sources.note: Original indexed collection record read: Nguyen dynasty/Bao Dai, issued Vietnam1926 to 1945, copper alloy,18mm,1.27g,four-character inscription. Does not expose inscription reading; no reconstructed coin text supplied. Acquisition1983 not production date.
